step-5-preview.tagline: 600B flagship that ties Kimi K3 on AA
highlights: 600B MoE, 27B active, 1M context; weights slated for 10/15
AA Intelligence Index 43.7, level with Kimi K3 (43.6)
$0.72 per AA task, about 1/2.8 the cost of K3
Hands-on tests: rock-steady output, grinds agent loops to the limit
step-5-preview.notes: low/medium/high effort tiers merged. API-only preview for now; weights due 10/15. AA says it trails peers on agentic evals; frontend, 3D and aesthetics are weak spots.
